title: Ridgeline Project Loan Draw Period and Repayment Terms
content:
Ridgeline Consumer Credit offers its installment product, the Ridgeline Project Loan, in three terms. Each loan opens with a draw period during which purchases may be drawn against it, followed by a repayment period of fixed monthly installments.

| | Card Classic | Card Preferred | Card Premier | Project Loan 66 | Project Loan 78 | Project Loan 84 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Draw period after loan opening (months) | 0 | 0 | 0 | 6 | 6 | 6 |
| Monthly installments in the repayment period | 0 | 0 | 0 | 66 | 78 | 84 |
| Draw-period payments are interest-only | No | No | No | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| A return credit in the draw period restores the amount available to draw | No | No | No | Yes | Yes | Yes |

**Notes**

- A figure of 0 in the first two lines marks a revolving card, which has no draw period and no installment term.
- On every Project Loan tier, payments due during the 6-month draw period are interest-only, and the repayment period that follows runs for the number of installments the loan's name carries: 66, 78 or 84.
- On every Project Loan tier, a return credit posted during the draw period restores the amount available to draw.

Hypothetical reading: a Ridgeline Project Loan 78 opened in a given month draws for 6 months and then repays in 78 monthly installments.
